title: Long application histories exceeded the native transport limit
origin: controlled temporary-SQLite reproduction followed by regression
expected: A hundred saved applications should remain inspectable without exceeding the 4 MB native response limit or repeating every answer in history.
observed: The pre-fix test produced a 6,059,443-character snapshot from 100 records with six 10,000-character answers each. History now returns summaries; the same regression passes below 200,000 characters and verifies full answers remain in storage. Exact review responses are unchanged.
evidence: scripts/qa/native-engine-browser.py background history and full-review journey
